title: Xbox Official Clears Up GTA6 PC Cloud Gaming Rumors
description: Following a recent report mix-up, an Xbox official has issued a clarifying statement regarding GTA6 availability on PC via Xbox Cloud Gaming.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Xbox Official Clears Up GTA6 PC Cloud Gaming Rumors

The anticipation surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming *Grand Theft Auto 6* means that any piece of news, whether accurate or misinterpreted, spreads like wildfire through the gaming community. Recently, gaming media outlet Polygon reported on a significant mix-up regarding the game's availability on PC through Xbox Cloud Gaming, prompting an official response from Xbox.

### The Source of the Report Mix-Up

In today's interconnected gaming ecosystem, cloud streaming services like Xbox Cloud Gaming have blurred the traditional lines between hardware platforms. However, following a recent report mix-up that tied the much-anticipated title to PC cloud availability speculations, confusion quickly spread across various forums and social media platforms. Given Rockstar's historical track record of prioritizing console launches for major titles before considering other platforms, any mention of PC accessibility naturally draws intense scrutiny.

### Official Clarification and Industry Context

According to Polygon, an Xbox official stepped forward to clear the air regarding the confusion. While the statement was primarily focused on straightening out the crossed wires from the initial reports, it highlights how sensitive the community is to anything related to *GTA6* platforms. 

As of now, Rockstar Games has not outlined explicit plans regarding a PC version or specific cloud gaming integrations outside of their official announcements. Players and industry watchers should continue to rely strictly on official communications from the publisher rather than getting carried away by rapid report iterations and platform speculations.

## Editor's Take

This incident is a prime example of the intense spotlight under which *GTA6* currently sits. A simple report mix-up can quickly morph into widespread platform rumors. Kudos to the Xbox official for swiftly clearing up the confusion, reminding us all of the importance of verifying information sources in the modern gaming news cycle.
